entry.description: `%exception{message}`, `{source}`, `{stacktrace}`, `{targetsite}` and `{helplink}` no longer cut the record when the exception's member throws. The rest of the record, its line end included, was lost, and the next record followed on the same line. The converter now writes `<log4net.Error>Exception reading message</log4net.Error>` for the member and reports the failure through the internal log (ANT-2026-O16FBEKV, fixed by @FreeAndNil)
